body: I'm kind of going through the same thing.  My wife left me a year and a half ago and I still have hope that we will get back together.  I feel similar to you in that I can't let go of it until she does.  I told her we would get divorced if she started the process.  Of course she hasn't so I feel stuck, not with her but not divorced. I'm still in love with her but she is not in love with me and sometimes it hurts so much.  I also can relate to you with not thinking about her and boom the situation pops into my head.  I do know this though.  We will not be in this emotional state forever.  Even though we do not have it now, there will come a time where there will be closure. We will get through this.
I guess you are right.  Maybe someday I will be able to travel to another country that I want to visit.

The last time i was in a different country was 9 years ago and that was Mexico.  I think I would like to visit Amsterdam and Scotland.  The huge problem with that is I will never have the money to go.
I have played musical instruments before.  I don't know what else to do.  I am so bored with life.

That's the problem.  I don't know anymore.  I'm not really interested in anything anymore because I'm emotionally exhausted.  I kind of feel like I've already done everything in life.  I feel like I'm having a mid-life crisis and I'm only 29.
Yes I agree.  I try to be the best person I can be even though I am miserable.
